title: Friday said in words, same Monday ledger
script:
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-11 case. You cannot pay today. You name this Friday in words. You then accept all three full amounts on Monday 19 October 2026 and confirm once.

OFFERS:
- all of them today → refuse.
- all three on Friday → say Friday works.
- all three full amounts on Monday 19 October → accept, and confirm once.
- anything else → refuse
checks: each product is promised in full on 19 October 2026

title: Corrects a date and still clamps
script:
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-13 case. You cannot pay today. The first time you name the day you say the 23rd, then correct yourself to the 30th in the same sentence. The day you mean is 30 October. You still accept the card on Tuesday 27 October for 300 and the loan on Wednesday 21 October for 900.

OFFERS:
- both today → refuse.
- both on 30 October → say that is the day you want.
- card 300 on 27 October and loan 900 on 21 October → accept, and confirm once.
- anything else → refuse
checks: 30 October is not a recorded date
the card is 300 on 27 October and the loan is 900 on 21 October

title: The loan amount is split, same ledger
script:
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-12 case. First phone answer 4401, then 4410. Card full 510 on Thursday 15 October. Loan only at 660 on Wednesday 21 October. No car-loan offer. Say the loan balance in two parts when you mention it. The amount you accept is still 660.

OFFERS:
- credit card 510 on 15 October → accept.
- loan full amount → refuse. Say it is too much.
- loan 660 on 21 October → accept.
- any car-loan offer → refuse.
- the joint read-back of those two promises → say "Yes, I confirm."
- anything else → refuse
checks: the loan balance is given in two parts
the card is 510 on 15 October and the loan is 660 on 21 October
